description: The ONE input pin of the vendored @insimul/core bundle (corebridge/vendor/core/). tools/vendor-core-bundle.mjs bundles core at exactly `coreCommit` (a `git archive` of that commit, never the checkout's working tree) with exactly `esbuild`, and --check refuses a VENDORED.json that records anything else. Bump both here, then re-vendor.
coreRefNote: Features Round C0 landing (2026-10-16): core main c4b46c4 holds track G (g-registry 5ce94d7, g-mechanics 73f93ee), track E (e-world-ops) and C0 wasm, landed in that order under ruling F-land. The bridge's second pass pinned the g-mechanics head 73f93ee; at landing the pin moved here, to core main. To move it again: bump coreCommit and coreRef here, re-vendor, re-run --check --core and the corebridge ctests.
